description: Use when adding structured data / JSON-LD / schema markup to a Shopify store: recipe, FAQ, Article/BlogPosting, CollectionPage, AboutPage, or Organization schema; chasing Google rich-results / rich-snippet eligibility; debugging a Search Console "Invalid object type" or "missing field" schema error; or a request like "add schema to my store", "add recipe schema", or "why isn't my product showing rich results". This skill adds SUPPLEMENTAL JSON-LD the theme cannot emit dynamically, stored in a metafield and rendered by one Liquid snippet. Not for meta titles, meta descriptions, canonical tags, or Open Graph (use shopify-seo-metadata for those).
